title: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management

changes.label: New role
changes.role: Senior Vice President & Head - Corporate Human Resources

profile.quote: Dr. C. Jayakumar is a distinguished HR leader with over 38 years of rich and diverse experience in strategic HRM & organizational transformation. As the CHRO of L&T Ltd., he has played a pivotal role in shaping the people agenda of one of India's top conglomerates. An alumnus of LBS, Dr. Jayakumar holds a doctorate in leadership, certification in executive coaching from CFI.
profile.summary: C Jayakumar is an experienced HR leader with over 38 years of expertise in strategic HRM and organizational transformation, currently serving as CHRO at L&T.

changes.label: New role
changes.role: Senior Vice President & IC Head - CarbonLite Solutions IC & Chief Executive – LMB

profile.quote: Mr. Suresh Kumar Narang, Sr. Vice President & Head – L&T Energy-CarbonLite Solutions, has over four decades of experience across the power sector, spanning thermal power project design, EPC execution, operations, commercial management, coal mining, and consulting. Since joining L&T in 2010, he has led several landmark initiatives, including the execution of India’s first Ultra Supercritical Power Project at Khargone for NTPC.
profile.summary: Suresh Kumar Narang has over 40 years of experience in the power sector, including project design, EPC execution, and operations, and has led significant initiatives at L&T since 2010.

changes.label: New role
changes.role: Senior Vice President & IC Head - Transportation Infrastructure IC

profile.quote: Mr. S. Ramkumar is an Electrical Engineer from NIT Durgapur and an alumnus of the London Business School Senior Executive Programme. With over three decades at Larsen & Toubro, he currently heads the Transportation Infrastructure Division, encompassing the Roads, Bridges & Formations (RBF) and Railway Business Groups (RBG).
profile.summary: S Ramkumar is an electrical engineer with over 30 years of experience at L&T, currently leading the Transportation Infrastructure Division.

changes.label: New role
changes.role: Senior Vice President & IC Head - Residential, Commercial Buildings & Factories IC

profile.quote: Mr. T. Sriraman joined L&T as a Graduate Engineer Trainee in 1992 and has over 34 years of experience across diverse functions and business verticals within L&T Construction. His areas of expertise include project execution, contracts, procurement, business development, and business strategy.
profile.summary: Sriraman T has over 34 years of experience at L&T Construction, specializing in project execution, contracts, procurement, and business strategy.
